integrity: An analytic facet-incidence proof and an exact spherical-cone calculation underpin the formula. A separately executable finite arithmetic and random-orientation checker corroborates but does not prove the infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: Fixed regular truncated octahedron and uniformly oriented central planes only; no translated-plane or section-size law. The 2024 broad section-enumeration publication was accessible only at abstract level. No independent historical-priority or scientific audit has been carried out.
title: Exact Haar polygon-count law for central sections of the regular truncated octahedron
